subject: general
question:
In the figure, O is the centre of the circle. If angle ARS = 125^circ, then find the measure of angle PAB. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/99c9dde9198d546be263088342c0a9cbd9708d39ced789d8e0469aa436903990.png]
solution:
**Given:**

∠ ARS = 125^circ

**Concept:**

Angle made in a semi-circle is a right angle.

Angles formed in the same segment of a circle will be equal in measure.

**Calculation:**

BR is formed by joining B and R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ce968c4c30d7cc0f82f11c44076814cd0feac401222e25e67fbd0967db33f01b.png] 

∠ARS + ∠ARP = 180° [Linear Pair]

⇒ ∠ARP = 180° - 125° = 55° 

∠ARB = 90° [Angle made in semi-circle] 

⇒ ∠ARP + ∠BRP = 90° 

⇒ ∠BRP = 90° - 55° = 35° 

∠BRP = ∠PAB = 35° [Angles made in the same segement]

**∴ ∠PAB = 35°**
